question: What is the average price across all genres shown? (A) about $6 (B) about $9 (C) about $12. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the steam bar chart. The y-axis starts just below the smallest bar instead of at 0, exaggerating differences. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): truncated axis. True answer: B (about $9). Bait: C (about $12).
